purpose: Bridge between Dekker et al. (2020) Int J LCA 9-category GloboDiet aggregation and the 10 CNF FoodGroupName buckets that cnf_integrator.get_environmental_impact_factors keys on. Used as documentation of the coarse-grouping precedent and as a future remapping table if per-Dekker-group ReCiPe midpoints become available (e.g. via author request for raw SimaPro outputs — see code_action_items.md TODO-CODE-LCA-1).
note: Direction is 1-to-many: each Dekker GloboDiet group corresponds to one or more CNF FoodGroupName buckets, and each CNF bucket may need to combine multiple Dekker groups (eggs are bundled with meat in Dekker; nuts with fruit; legumes/potatoes with vegetables).

cnf_to_dekker.Dairy and Egg Products: Dairy (note: eggs in Dekker are bundled into Meat)

asymmetries: Dekker bundles eggs into Meat; CNF bundles eggs into Dairy and Egg Products.
Dekker bundles nuts/seeds into Fruit; CNF separates them.
Dekker bundles potatoes + legumes into Vegetables; CNF separates Legumes.
implication_for_grounding: If per-Dekker-group ReCiPe midpoint means were obtained from the authors, the cross-walk above is necessary but not sufficient: e.g. mapping Dekker 'Meat' (which contains eggs and a wide protein spread from lamb to chicken to ham) onto CNF 'Beef Products' would inherit the wrong magnitude without further re-weighting by sub-category protein content. A direct license-and-rescore path (TODO-CODE-LCA-2) avoids this aggregation lossiness.
